scope: Outside helpers only; no change or additional authority for the already-running campaign.

findings.issue: Recorded final selection is checked against all architecture IDs instead of executed, fully completed selected-budget configurations. A30-fit completed fixture accepts unrun R2-identity as the final winner although all R2 records are NOT_RUN.
findings.recommendation: Validate the recorded selection against the locked B-star or authorized C0/R0 using the common normalizer and all three verified completed seed records. Require complete B24 evidence for the baseline lock and reused PRIOR/LATE reference. Do not choose a replacement winner or run models.

findings.issue: Condition exporter marks output VERIFIED without terminal campaign evidence, source_verification, or actual checkpoint-byte verification. Existing1-fit synthetic fixture has none of these files but successfully exports96condition scores as official evidence.
findings.recommendation: Require a successfully verified main-export manifest bound to the same campaign/events/evaluation bytes and source/counts, terminal status and selected checkpoint bytes. Preserve descriptive-only aggregation and partial-seed null summaries; no source data, extra evaluation or re-selection is needed.

confirmed_correct: Clean classification metrics are recomputed from fixed-three-class confusion matrices.
Condition score arithmetic calls the hash-verified frozen aggregate, with replicate then equal-condition then seed weighting.
Partial seed sets retain null across-seed aggregates. Failed/uncompleted fits are not promoted to completed metrics.
Observed output allowlists omit raw paths, sample rows, predictions, labels, masks and pairing digests. Checkpoint files are streamed for hashes only by main exporter.
No exporter performs model selection or evaluation.
limits: This is an integrity check of existing aggregate evidence, not proof of predictive performance or raw-source truth.
Full-grid F1/MAE are already-computed metrics; no raw predictions or labels are read to recompute them.
These initial findings were passed to the separate exporter author for outside-only fixes; current running model implementation is unaffected.
